brief.en: Shoots frozen peas that damage and slow zombies

description.en: Snow Peas fire frozen peas making it hard for zombies to advance.
description.zh: 寒冰射手发射寒冰子弹，能使僵尸前进变得缓慢。

chat.en: As a professional table tennis player, in the off-season he also enjoys skiing, playing the bongos, and spelunking.
chat.zh: 作为专业的乒乓球运动员，休赛期间他还会去滑翔，打手鼓，甚至是探洞穴。

text.en: chills and damages zombie on impact
text.zh: 子弹会对僵尸造成伤害并冰冻
